title: CRM
html:
The CRM module of Infinity can be used on its own as well as integrated into the business processes. It follows two approaches:

  • Lead-based: it models the sales process

  • Project-based: it enables full project management

Everything is possible, from simple data collection all the way to an almost fully automated sales process. Any data can be stored about partners, custom questionnaires can be created, an efficient customer service can be operated, and by recording working time on CRM events you get feedback on the human resource needs of the projects.
